versos.hebraico: תְּ֭פִלָּה לְעָנִ֣י כִֽי־יַעֲטֹ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ שִׂיחֽוֹ׃
יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְעָ֣ה תְפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י אֵלֶ֥יךָ תָבֽוֹא׃

controles.web: Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
controles.kjv: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come unto thee.
controles.livre: Ó SENHOR, ouve minha oração; e que meu clamor chegue a ti.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ׀ מִמֶּנִּי֮ בְּי֪וֹם צַ֫ר לִ֥י הַטֵּֽה־אֵלַ֥י אָזְנֶ֑ךָ בְּי֥וֹם אֶ֝קְרָ֗א מַהֵ֥ר עֲנֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
controles.kjv: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
controles.livre: Não escondas de mim o teu rosto no dia da minha angústia; inclina a mim teu ouvidos; no dia em que eu clamar, apressa-te para me responder.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־כָל֣וּ בְעָשָׁ֣ן יָמָ֑י וְ֝עַצְמוֹתַ֗י כְּמוֹ־קֵ֥ד נִחָֽרוּ׃

controles.web: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
controles.kjv: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
controles.livre: Porque os meus dias têm se desfeito como fumaça; e meus ossos se têm se queimado como n um forno.

versos.hebraico: הוּכָּֽה־כָ֭עֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַ֣שׁ לִבִּ֑י כִּֽי־שָׁ֝כַ֗חְתִּי מֵאֲכֹ֥ל לַחְמִֽי׃

controles.web: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
controles.kjv: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
controles.livre: Meu coração, tal como a erva, está tão ferido e seco, que me esqueci de comer meu pão.

versos.hebraico: מִקּ֥וֹל אַנְחָתִ֑י דָּבְקָ֥ה עַ֝צְמִ֗י לִבְשָׂרִֽי׃

controles.web: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.
controles.kjv: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
controles.livre: Por causa da voz do meu gemido, meus ossos têm se grudado à minha carne.

versos.hebraico: דָּ֭מִיתִי לִקְאַ֣ת מִדְבָּ֑ר הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כְּכ֣וֹס חֳרָבֽוֹת׃

controles.web: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.
controles.kjv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
controles.livre: Estou semelhante a uma ave no deserto, estou como uma coruja num lugar desabitado.

versos.hebraico: שָׁקַ֥דְתִּי וָאֶֽהְיֶ֑ה כְּ֝צִפּ֗וֹר בּוֹדֵ֥ד עַל־גָּֽג׃

controles.web: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.
controles.kjv: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
controles.livre: Fico alerta e estou como um pardal solitário sobre o telhado.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם חֵרְפ֣וּנִי אוֹיְבָ֑י מְ֝הוֹלָלַ֗י בִּ֣י נִשְׁבָּֽעוּ׃

controles.web: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.
controles.kjv: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
controles.livre: Os meus inimigos me insultam o dia todo; os que me odeiam juram maldições contra mim.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־אֵ֭פֶר כַּלֶּ֣חֶם אָכָ֑לְתִּי וְ֝שִׁקֻּוַ֗י בִּבְכִ֥י מָסָֽכְתִּי׃

controles.web: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
controles.kjv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
controles.livre: Porque estou comendo cinza como se fosse pão, e misturo minha bebida com lágrimas,

versos.hebraico: מִפְּנֵֽי־זַֽעַמְךָ֥ וְקִצְפֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נְ֝שָׂאתַ֗נִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Because of your indignation and your wrath, for you have taken me up, and thrown me away.
controles.kjv: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
controles.livre: Por causa de tua irritação e tua ira; porque tu me levantaste e me derrubaste.

versos.hebraico: יָ֭מַי כְּצֵ֣ל נָט֑וּי וַ֝אֲנִ֗י כָּעֵ֥שֶׂב אִיבָֽשׁ׃

controles.web: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
controles.kjv: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
controles.livre: Meus dias têm sido como a sombra, que declina; e eu estou secando como a erva.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וְ֝זִכְרְךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

controles.web: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
controles.kjv: But thou, O Lord, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
controles.livre: Porém tu, SENHOR, permaneces para sempre; e tua lembrança continua geração após geração.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּ֣ה תָ֭קוּם תְּרַחֵ֣ם צִיּ֑וֹן כִּי־עֵ֥ת לְ֝חֶֽנְנָ֗הּ כִּי־בָ֥א מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
controles.livre: Tu te levantarás, e terás piedade de Sião; porque chegou o tempo determinado para se apiedar dela.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־רָצ֣וּ עֲ֭בָדֶיךָ אֶת־אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְֽאֶת־עֲפָרָ֥הּ יְחֹנֵֽנוּ׃

controles.web: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.
controles.kjv: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
controles.livre: Pois os teus servos se agradam de suas pedras, e sentem compaixão do pó de suas ruínas .

versos.hebraico: וְיִֽירְא֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וְֽכָל־מַלְכֵ֥י הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name; all the kings of the earth your glory.
controles.kjv: So the heathen shall fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
controles.livre: Então as nações temerão o nome do SENHOR; e todos os reis da terra temerão a tua glória;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־בָנָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה צִיּ֑וֹן נִ֝רְאָ֗ה בִּכְבוֹדֽוֹ׃

controles.web: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
controles.kjv: When the Lord shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
controles.livre: Quando o SENHOR edificar a Sião, e aparecer em sua glória;

versos.hebraico: פָּ֭נָה אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֣ת הָעַרְעָ֑ר וְלֹֽא־בָ֝זָ֗ה אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָֽם׃

controles.web: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
controles.kjv: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
controles.livre: E der atenção à oração do desamparado, e não desprezar sua oração.

versos.hebraico: תִּכָּ֣תֶב זֹ֭את לְד֣וֹר אַחֲר֑וֹן וְעַ֥ם נִ֝בְרָ֗א יְהַלֶּל־יָֽהּ׃

controles.web: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah.
controles.kjv: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the Lord.
controles.livre: Isto será escrito para a geração futura; e o povo que for criado louvará ao SENHOR;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־הִ֭שְׁקִיף מִמְּר֣וֹם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַ֤יִם׀ אֶל־אֶ֬רֶץ הִבִּֽיט׃

controles.web: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;
controles.kjv: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the Lord behold the earth;
controles.livre: Porque ele olhará desde o alto de seu santuário; o SENHOR olhará desde os céus para a terra,

versos.hebraico: לִ֭שְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַ֣ת אָסִ֑יר לְ֝פַתֵּ֗חַ בְּנֵ֣י תְמוּתָֽה׃

controles.web: to hear the groans of the prisoner; to free those who are condemned to death;
controles.kjv: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
controles.livre: Para ouvir o gemido dos prisioneiros; para soltar aos sentenciados à morte.

versos.hebraico: לְסַפֵּ֣ר בְּ֭צִיּוֹן שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝תְהִלָּת֗וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

controles.web: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
controles.kjv: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
controles.livre: Para eles anunciarem o nome do SENHOR em Sião, e seu louvor em Jerusalém.

versos.hebraico: בְּהִקָּבֵ֣ץ עַמִּ֣ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וּ֝מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לַעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.
controles.kjv: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
controles.livre: Quando os povos se reunirem, e os reinos, para servirem ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: עִנָּ֖ה בַדֶּ֥רֶךְ כחו קִצַּ֥ר יָמָֽי׃

controles.web: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.
controles.kjv: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
controles.livre: Ele abateu minha força no caminho; abreviou os meus dias.

versos.hebraico: אֹמַ֗ר אֵלִ֗י אַֽל־תַּ֭עֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִ֣י יָמָ֑י בְּד֖וֹר דּוֹרִ֣ים שְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the midst of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
controles.kjv: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
controles.livre: Eu dizia: Meu Deus, não me leves no meio dos meus dias; teus anos são eternos ,geração após geração.

versos.hebraico: לְ֭פָנִים הָאָ֣רֶץ יָסַ֑דְתָּ וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדֶ֣יךָ שָׁמָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.
controles.kjv: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
controles.livre: Desde muito antes fundaste a terra; e os céus são obra de tuas mãos.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֤מָּה׀ יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְאַתָּ֪ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭כֻלָּם כַּבֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֑וּ כַּלְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣ם וְֽיַחֲלֹֽפוּ׃

controles.web: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.
controles.kjv: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
controles.livre: Eles se destruirão, porém tu permanecerás; e todos eles como vestimentas se envelhecerão; como roupas tu os mudarás, e serão mudados.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּה־ה֑וּא וּ֝שְׁנוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִתָּֽמּוּ׃

controles.web: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
controles.kjv: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
controles.livre: Porém tu és o mesmo; e teus anos nunca se acabarão.

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵֽי־עֲבָדֶ֥יךָ יִשְׁכּ֑וֹנוּ וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם לְפָנֶ֥יךָ יִכּֽוֹן׃

controles.web: The children of your servants will continue. Their seed will be established before you.”
controles.kjv: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
controles.livre: Os filhos de teus servos habitarão seguros ,e a semente deles será firmada perante ti.
